acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce with one bounded long-running command and compare compact wait_threads with read_thread during execution and after completion.
Expose active deterministic wait/command state or document an explicit unknown with a bounded supported inspection fallback; preserve source-command identity.
Verify cancellation joins owned processes and cannot be inferred as remote job cancellation; retain exact host/version and command timelines.
body: Observed coordination friction on 2026-10-03 in Codex desktop; exact app version NOT_OBSERVED. Corvint Core build163 and Tasks build202 were installed. A delegated read-only CI watcher for PR491 remained active while wait_threads repeatedly reported latestToolMarker exec-9d7afa39-bd47-4172-bff0-264868df60a8 (completed gh run view) and an unchanged cursor12. After stopping the watch, read_thread disclosed exec-889a13b4-6429-43cd-86af-aaff38d1fd3f: gh run watch 37121925253 --repo beamfall/corvint --interval 30 --exit-status, duration937811ms, exit130. The actual long-running command was not represented by the compact latest marker until completion. ROOT initially inferred lack of active observation, then corrected that inference after reading the command record. Expected: compact coordination exposes the current in-flight command/wait, or explicitly marks in-flight state unknown; a prior completed marker should not be mistaken for current activity. Actual: active chat plus prior completed marker gave no way to distinguish ongoing deterministic wait from a stalled agent without expanded history. Root cause and reproducibility remain UNCONFIRMED; this is an investigation item, not a proven model or Core defect. No remote CI cancellation occurred; watcher confirmed all owned processes joined. Evidence: thread01a0fa7c-beef-7602-b8ba-3b04220e2dff, turn01a101ac-50aa-7ce3-9e11-93ebb30eaf3b, cursors20c29206-e0a0-4713-9710-b4f5cd33ed77:12 through:14. Dedup searches watcher/poll/wait_threads/latestToolMarker/active command found no same issue; V1-0550 concerns a separate queued-owner identity gap.
title: Investigate Codex compact status omitting an active long-running command
